audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was Urgot's on this page while the mirror gives that stage to Sion; and Levels 3, 4-5 and First item read as Sion's here though whys[2], whys[3], whys[5] and mid all say those stages are yours.
audit.why: The mirror audit (sion vs urgot) states it flipped phases[4]/win[4] to Sion with the rating inverted, so Level 6 must read Sion on both pages. The other rows disagree with packet.levelChart and with this page's own prose, but the mirror did not report moving them, so flipping them here could create a fresh disagreement — flagged instead.
audit.corrected: Level 6 flipped to Sion in both layers, rating 7/10 -> 3/10. Rows 0-3 and 5 left as they stand, with a question raised.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as your spike with a 25% execute number and no mention of Unstoppable Onslaught.
audit.why: Riot kit: Unstoppable Onslaught is 140/100/60s and charges from up to 7500 units, knocking up on collision — Disdain cannot stop it and does not flip him out of it. Fear Beyond Death's threshold is unnumbered in Riot's text.
audit.corrected: Level 6 belongs to Sion: his R is 140s at rank 1, uncounterable by your flip. Bait the charge, then trade and use the execute threshold afterwards.

audit.whatIsWrong: Decimating Smash is described as a flat knockup with no cooldown or charge condition, and the page never warns that Soul Furnace and Glory in Death scale on your maximum health.
audit.why: Riot kit: Decimating Smash is 10/9/8/7/6s and only knocks up when charged long enough — a tapped cast is chip damage. Soul Furnace is 15/14/13/12/11s and reactivates 3s later for damage flagged percentHealth; the revive passive also deals bonus damage on your max health. Stacking raw HP against him is punished.
audit.corrected: Only a full charge on Decimating Smash knocks up — walk out of the arc while he winds up. Soul Furnace detonates 3 seconds after the shield goes up and scales on your maximum health, so step out rather than tank it.

edits.before: Fear Beyond Death online — at 25% HP Sion is simply dead. Trade him to half, then the chain threat decides everything.
edits.after: Unstoppable Onslaught lands — 140s at rank 1, and Disdain cannot flip him out of the charge. Bait it, then trade.

edits.before: Your R flips a step-up Sion into your team at 6.
edits.after: Level 6 is his; his R charge cannot be flipped.

edits.before: R Fear Beyond Death punishes a Sion who steps up to farm — reel him into your jungler and his lack of mobility means he can't escape the flip.
edits.after: Sion's R is 140s at rank 1 and Disdain will not stop the charge. Bait it out, then reel him in with Fear Beyond Death and finish him at range.

edits.before: - Sion Decimating Smash (Stun): matchup-defining — Charged = knockup. Sidestep it. Track it before every engage. - Sion Decimating Smash: Charged swing; fully charged it knocks up in a big area. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Decimating Smash: 10s at rank 1; only a full charge knocks up, so walk out of the arc while he winds up. - Soul Furnace: 15s, detonating 3s after the shield. - Unstoppable Onslaught: 140s.

edits.before: Charged = knockup. Sidestep it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Only a full charge knocks up; a quick tap just chips. Walk out of the arc.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Soul Furnace detonates for damage scaling on your max health — step out first.

edits.before: Late game your R is a pick machine: any frontliner dropped under 25% dies through everything. Anchor fights around the execute threat and W-shred whoever dives your carries. Sion carry threat: 6/10 — end the game before he cashes it.
edits.after: Late game your R is a pick machine: anyone dropped under its threshold dies through everything. Anchor fights around the execute threat and W-shred whoever dives your carries. Sion carry threat: 6/10 — end before he cashes it.

notes: Sion Q's listed range of 10000 in the kit file is a data artifact and was not used. Urgot's Q carries a 'dash' flag contradicting Riot's description, so the missingInteractions line built on it was ignored — but the resistances-invalidated line is real and was written in (Soul Furnace and Glory in Death both scale on the target's maximum health, so raw HP stacking is punished against him).
